security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Live chord identification for MIDI keyboards.
bundle.longDescription: Keyscene listens to your MIDI keyboard and shows the chord you are playing — name, alternates, Roman numeral, staff notation, and an on-screen keyboard — with a chrome-free Display mode for OBS and screen sharing.
